meta.title: La France en Profondeur: Strategic Atlas
meta.description: Atlas of French national strategy. Ten domains examine French practice in independent defence, critical industries, and global sovereignty.

a11y.homeCrest: Crest of the French Football Federation, return to home

scenario.notice: Figures marked as scenario describe the R.I.F. 2035 to 2040 projection, a fictional world distinct from current reality.

arsenal.name: ARSENAL
arsenal.sub: Ultimate security is not delegated to allies.
arsenal.how: Independent deterrence tous azimuts relies on entirely sovereign defence equipment.
arsenal.what: About 700 warheads (scenario), 8 SNLE (scenario), Rafale, Suffren-class attack submarines.

statecraft.name: STATECRAFT
statecraft.sub: State decisions do not yield to allied votes.
statecraft.how: Fifth Republic presidential authority and Gaullist tradition sustain independent diplomacy.
statecraft.what: 1966 exit from NATO integrated command, 2009 return, European Intervention Initiative.

epochs.name: EPOCHS
epochs.sub: Present capabilities were born of ruptures.
epochs.how: State power rebuilt itself through centralisation, the Revolution, the Civil Code, and Gaullism.
epochs.what: Data source for the site timeline, tracking major foundational historical ruptures.

territories.name: TERRITORIES
territories.how: Overseas territories, an 11 million km² EEZ, and military footholds secure global reach.
territories.what: Sovereign presence across six continents, second largest exclusive economic zone in the world.

arena.name: ARENA
arena.sub: Sport displays national unity and integration.
arena.how: The republican integration model is backed by sustained public investment in sport.
arena.what: World Cup victories, republican integration narrative embodied by Kylian Mbappé.

aesthetics.name: AESTHETICS
aesthetics.how: The cultural exception and state support protect domestic cinema, fashion, and the arts.
aesthetics.what: Cannes Film Festival, Louvre Museum, Paris+ contemporary art fair.

science.name: SCIENCE
science.how: Leading contributor to CNRS, CNES, and ESA, the state directs national quantum and AI plans.
science.what: Ariane 6 launcher, Mistral AI, 13 Fields Medal recipients.

economy.name: ECONOMY
economy.sub: Economic scale funds defence and diplomacy.
economy.how: CAC 40 multinationals, agricultural autonomy, and luxury capital consolidate economic scale.
economy.what: Seventh largest global GDP, LVMH ranked first worldwide in luxury.

francophonie.name: FRANCOPHONIE
francophonie.sub: Language and culture secure lasting influence.
francophonie.how: The 88-state OIF network is supported by Instituts français and Alliances françaises worldwide.
francophonie.what: 320 million current speakers, projected 700 to 800 million users by 2050.

industry.name: INDUSTRY
industry.sub: Autonomy requires control of key supply chains.
industry.how: An integrated industrial base links energy, defence, electronics, transport, and sovereign luxury.
industry.what: Autonomous Rafale production, EPR2 nuclear reactors, Ariane 6 space launcher.

hero.subtitle: LA FRANCE EN PROFONDEUR
hero.tagline: France is not a country, it is an idea.
hero.lede: Across ten domains, including defence, industry, institutions, and culture, this atlas records France’s concrete practice in maintaining strategic autonomy in the 21st century.
hero.imageAlt: Collage cut diagonally showing Marianne, the Eiffel Tower, a Rafale fighter and a submarine.

heroQuote.text: « Toute ma vie, je me suis fait une certaine idée de la France. »
heroQuote.translation: All my life, I have had a certain idea of France.
heroQuote.attribution: Charles de Gaulle · Mémoires de guerre, 1954

stats.francophone: Countries with French as an official language

matrix.title: Ten dimensions of strategic autonomy
matrix.intro: Every module follows the same structure: the motive, the system, and the results.

i.title: Decision autonomy
i.body: Supreme state decisions are not ceded to a military alliance, nor governed by any outside market.

ii.title: A complete system
ii.body: Defence industry, overseas territories, institutions, and culture form a fully independent sovereign system.

iii.title: Global projection
iii.body: Sovereign territories across all oceans and core industries maintain the state’s global reach.

citation.text: « La politique de toutes les puissances est dans leur géographie. »
citation.translation: The policy of all powers is in their geography.
citation.attribution: Napoleon I · Letter to the King of Prussia, 10 November 1804
